2788-ray-marching-and-discretization.md.summary: Ray Marching is an iterative algorithm that approximates continuous light transport with discrete samples to render semi-transparent volumes without surface extraction, focusing on the integration loop rather than voxel traversal.

3462-density-marching.md.summary: Density Marching is a direct volume rendering technique that samples a 3D density field along rays using a fixed number of steps, differing from adaptive methods by its simplicity and inefficiency for sparse volumes.

1334-discrete-volume-rendering-integral..summary: The Discrete Volume Rendering Integral approximates the continuous rendering equation using Riemann sums, distinguishing itself from analytical and higher-order methods by assuming constant density and color within each discretized ray segment.

8996-generalizable-radiance-fields-via-t.summary: Generalizable Radiance Fields via Transformer Attention uses transformer attention to aggregate multi-view features, enabling rapid inference on unseen scenes without per-scene optimization.
